description:
FILED s514a (Opus, 2026-10-10), found by the lib/Storable.pm probe matrix (pr/st2.pl row "rx subclass").

Reproducer (scratch/s514a/pr/rxb4.pl), perl 5.40.3 vs PCL main 4d2fc9f0:

    my $sub = bless qr/zz/, "MyRx";
    my @a = ($sub); my $c = $sub; my $r = [$sub]; sub f { ref($_[0]) }
    print ref($a[0]), " ", ref($c), " ", ref($r->[0]), " ", f($sub), "\n";
    # perl: MyRx MyRx MyRx MyRx        PCL: Regexp MyRx Regexp Regexp

So the class rides on the scalar's BOX (`my $c = $sub` keeps it, as the box copy does) and not on the regexp object, and every copy that stores the raw value (array element, argument) drops it.  perl blesses the REGEXP referent; every reference to it sees the class.  Consequence seen: Storable's writer (and any `ref`/`blessed` dispatch on a qr subclass passed as an argument) sees `Regexp`.

=== s543c (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-21, CODE 64353611) ===
VERDICT: FIXED -- `my $sub = bless qr/zz/, "MyRx"`: an array element, a scalar copy, an anon-array element and a sub argument all report MyRx
  (MyRx MyRx MyRx MyRx), a hash value too, and the element still matches -- = perl 5.40.3.
FIX: #4001 (the same bug filed again; Pl/t/blessed-copy-01.t names it) and s529a #3824 (a reference copied into a new array element is a new
  container, blessed or not).
GUARD: Pl/t/blessed-copy-01.t 'an ARRAY ELEMENT holding a BLESSED qr// reads back with its class (#4001)'.
CLOSE-WITH-ROWS: no baseline / registry / doc row is keyed on #3082.
subject: SILENT WRONG: a qr// object REBLESSED into another class loses the class when copied into an array or passed to a sub -- `my $s = bless qr/zz/, "MyRx"; ref([$s]->[0])` is Regexp in PCL, MyRx in perl (a plain scalar copy keeps it)
triage_reason: rare: a reblessed qr// loses its class when copied
